title: AI failure triage: classification, retrieval and evidence
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects ai failure triage: classification, retrieval and evidence with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Acceptance evidence includes held-out confusion metrics, retrieval Recall@K, valid citations, unknown-case escalation, p95 latency and cost per accepted task.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: A CI failure contains an exception, test identity, build context and history. The triage system must classify product, automation, environment, test-data or unknown causes without turning a plausible narrative into a confirmed defect. Similar failures provide evidence, not proof that two incidents share a root cause.
The portfolio result must be reproducible from the supplied synthetic fixtures and declared configuration. Keep a deterministic baseline visible alongside any live-provider results.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Build a grouped-split TF-IDF baseline, retrieve approved historical failures, then optionally ask a live model for a typed explanation with evidence IDs. Map probable owners from an explicit module registry rather than asking the model to invent a person. Export a report containing category, uncertainty, similar failures and review status.
The repository labs provide the domain entry points and fixture cases. Run the acceptance checks before recording project completion and keep the generated run ID in your field notes.

python -m pytest local-labs
python local-labs/evals/runner.py --output artifacts/evaluation
# Inspect JSON verdict and escaped HTML case report

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: The triage dataset contains 180 explicitly synthetic failures. Each record has a stable ID, incident group, tenant, module, category, log and duration. This stage produces an artifact used by the next stage of the same capstone. Preserve the dataset and operation identities so the reviewer can connect the implementation to its acceptance evidence.

paragraphs: A trained classifier learns a mapping from log features to failure labels. The TF-IDF/logistic pipeline is a measurable baseline; its preprocessing must be fitted only within training folds. Grouped cross-validation estimates configuration behavior before the final held-out test.
This stage produces an artifact used by the next stage of the same capstone. Preserve the dataset and operation identities so the reviewer can connect the implementation to its acceptance evidence.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism

Run the stated commands from the repository root after installing the companion lab dependencies. Keep fixture and live execution modes visible in every report; a passing fixture contract is not a live model-quality measurement.
